name: Benjamin Bonzi
intro: Benjamin Bonzi is from the south of France. His friends call him La Bonz. He is known for beating big stars and for a super backhand.
story: Benjamin grew up 400 meters from a tennis club. He walked there to play when he was tiny. In 2021 he won six smaller tournaments in one year. That ties the all-time record! Last year he beat star Daniil Medvedev right here in New York.

funFacts.text: He won his first trophy at age 10. He got a big bag of candy!
His first airplane ride was at 12. He flew to the Bahamas for a tennis event.
He loves video games. He plays PlayStation a lot at home.
His secret talent is biology. His favorite book is The Lord of the Rings.
His favorite shot is the volley, hit up close at the net.
In 2021 he won six smaller pro tournaments. Almost nobody has done that!
He beat Daniil Medvedev in five sets at the 2025 US Open.

watchFor: Watch for him rushing to the net to hit a volley, his favorite shot.
